family_reports.body: Years of abusive litigation by my ex -- that has gone unchecked by multiple courts in multiple jurisdictions -- destroyed my employment, savings, and mental health.
Destroyed by the system built to protect us. Safety and our voice doesn’t matter as much as you income in the family system.

This situation has caused long term emotional confusion, insecurity, and distress due to the sudden, unjust disruption of a primary bond at a young age, (4) compounded by years of instability and unsubstantiated, conflicting narratives that deprived us of a normal relationship for 4 years. Both my daughter, our extended family, and I continue to experience lingering grief, anxiety, and separation anxiety, with the pain of missing each other persisting through long stretches of time apart ... impacts will remain part of our emotional landscape forever. -Anonymous, Utah
